text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To gain experience on the big stage,
Inari One entered the Takarazuka Kinen.
The race 
also featured the "White Lightning," 
Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Under the tremendous pressure radiating 
from Tamamo Cross, who seemed like a 
completely different person from her 
academy self, the battle began.
